hypothesis: Anchoring to the prior year's high delays price adjustment; proximity to that high can rank subsequent returns better than accumulated past returns.
scope: A-share research adaptation, not a replication of the paper's holding schedule or US results
unique_change: Replace 12-1 return ranking by current adjusted close divided by maximum adjusted daily high over the last 252 market sessions, including signal day.
schedule: Month-end sessions whose next-open entry and entry+40 market-session endpoint fit completely in training data.
universe: Observed SH/SZ equities, valid signal OHLCV, raw close 3..300 CNY, signal amount >=20 million CNY, valid positive close at t-252 and t-21, at least 200 positive observations in trailing 252 market sessions; eligibility and both ranks frozen before future execution is inspected.
broad_reference: Equal signal-date allocations to all observed SH/SZ equities with valid signal OHLCV, evaluated under the same execution and endpoint rules before costs.
matching_reference: All eligible stocks under the same net execution rules, including unfilled allocations held as zero-interest cash.
groups: 10 equal percentile bands via average ranks; ties stay together; highest band is the long selection; never refill a failed buy with lower-ranked stocks.
execution: Reuse independent matcher: signal close, buy next market open, exit signal on endpoint-1 market day and sell endpoint open. No stops. Any matcher end liquidation before the common endpoint is treated as censored and marked to the last observed close, not as a sale.
unresolved_positions: Keep all candidates. Censored/stale marks disclosed by group; report sensitivity treating all censored positions as zero recovery. Do not compound overlapping cohort returns into an account curve.
limit_proxy: Use existing raw-price board limit flags without latest instrument names, plus a conservative one-price lock when adjusted return magnitude is >=4.5%, covering unknown historical ST names. This can reject tradable one-price sessions; exact ST/board-date/issuer lifecycle coverage is not claimed.
reports: selected-set replacement rate, not realized turnover

statistics.weighting: equal signal months, equal allocations within each group

pass_action: Retain as a training-supported ranking hypothesis; complete fixed rebalancing portfolio, actual turnover/drawdown and point-in-time execution evidence before any qualification.
fail_action: Stop this high-proximity ranking representation and its high-window, percentile, skip, horizon and gate combinations. Propose a causally distinct selection mechanism; no reverse-direction selection after seeing results.
